sailings.title: Grand Caribbean featuring St Lucia & Anguilla
sailings.body: Journey from Saint Lucia to Miami on a 14-night voyage through the Eastern Caribbean and Bahamian waters, where lush island landscapes, secluded beaches, and days on the water unfold in effortless rhythm. Departing from Saint Lucia, discover the French-Caribbean character of Martinique before a dedicated Marina Day in the British Virgin Islands invites time to swim and unwind. The voyage then turns toward the Bahamas, where Yacht Club Day at Norman’s Cay and a dedicated Marina Day offer a final expression of island leisure before your journey concludes in Miami.

sailings.title: Bahamas *featuring* Exuma Sound
sailings.body: The Bahamas’ sugar-white shores and crystalline waters have long welcomed sun-seekers from around the world. But the crown jewels of this beautiful archipelago are the Exumas, with their virgin beaches, swimming pigs, and water so brilliantly blue, it’s visible from outer space. With hundreds of sheltered bays and uninhabited islets to explore, this yachting haven provides endless opportunities for the captain to curate a truly unique journey — from an impromptu stop at a particularly lovely cove to an evening of cocktails on our vessel’s one-of-a-kind marina platform.

sailings.title: Grand Caribbean featuring Nevis & Dominica
sailings.body: Sail from Miami to Saint Lucia on an 18-night voyage that traces a graceful arc from the Bahamas into the southern reaches of the Caribbean. Begin with a dedicated Marina Day in Bahamian waters before continuing to Norman’s Cay for an exclusive Yacht Club Day. The journey then carries you through the British Virgin Islands, glamorous St. Barth’s, Prickly Pear, Nevis, and Guadeloupe before unfolding into the lush landscapes of Dominica and the French-Caribbean character of Martinique. A dedicated Marina Day in the Grenadines and a call in Tobago reveal a quieter, more unspoiled side of the region before your voyage concludes in Saint Lucia.

sailings.title: Grand Mediterranean *featuring* Egypt
sailings.body: This extended voyage places Egypt at the centre of a journey linking the ancient worlds of Greece and Türkiye. Depart from Athens and sail to Patmos, where the Monastery of St. John and the Cave of the Apocalypse mark sacred ground. Swim in the mirrored waters of Orak Island Bay and stroll Bodrum’s harbour, where antiquity and modernity coexist. Cross the Mediterranean to Marassi Marina El Alamein, a coastal haven near the site of pivotal Second World War battles, before spending three days in Alexandria. There, the catacombs of Kom el Shaqafa, the Citadel of Qaitbay, and the modern Bibliotheca Alexandrina evoke its Graeco-Roman legacy. On the return north, call at Delik Island and Marmaris, then Milos, before concluding in Athens, a voyage where Egypt anchors the enduring legacy of Mediterranean civilization.

sailings.body: Sail the Ionian and Aegean’s little-known wonders as history, culture, and secluded beauty weave an enticing tapestry. Begin in Corfu, where the UNESCO Old Town blends Venetian, French, and British influences in arcaded squares and pastel façades. Continue to Parga, a jewel of the Epirus coast, crowned by a Venetian fortress and framed by the famed Blue Lagoon. A Marina Day in Molos Gulf reveals golden sand, emerald waters, and a hilltop chapel that feels worlds away. Explore Pýlos, rich in Mycenaean legend, before crossing to Kos, a cosmopolitan crossroads with ancient ruins and a lively waterfront. Spend two nights in Marmaris, where a hilltop castle overlooks dazzling bazaars and animated nightlife. Visit Livadi, a Greek harbour rich in myth, before arriving in Athens, with its ancient landmarks and enduring appeal.

sailings.title: Greek Isles featuring Antiparos & Mykonos

Begin in Antiparos, where hidden sea caves, pristine beaches, and a chic Cycladic village create a celebrity-favorite escape. Spend a restorative Marina Day on Rineia, swimming in tranquil coves and crystal waters far from the crowds. Continue to Mykonos for two incredible nights, strolling past the shops, art galleries, and animated cafés of Little Venice, relaxing on remote northern beaches, and savouring organic wines at Vioma Farm. In Turgutreis, explore colourful bazaars filled with artful textiles and exotic spices before returning to Athens, where Plaka’s narrow streets and buzzing tavernas offer a fitting finale to your Aegean voyage.

sailings.title: Grand Mediterranean *featuring* Crete & Ischia
sailings.body: Embark in Athens and sail to Chania, where a Venetian fortress, Ottoman mosques, and waterfront tavernas reveal the many facets of Crete. Continue to Pýlos to swim in translucent waters beneath ancient Mycenaean hills. After a peaceful day at sea, arrive in Ischia for two nights of discovery, soaking in thermal hot springs, exploring vibrant piazzas, and visiting the historic island fortress of Castello Aragonese. Journey on to Porto Ercole, a Tuscan harbour of pastel façades and seaside cafés. Then cross to Corsica for a relaxed Marina Day in the Golfe de Saint-Florent, where unexplored coves and azure waters reward those who arrive by yacht. After taking in the private yachting enclave of  Mandelieu-la-Rague  along France’s Côte d’Azur, conclude your voyage in the elegance and sophistication of Monte Carlo.

Conclude in Nice, taking in its artistic penchant and vibrant energy for a fitting finale to your Riviera experience.

sailings.title: Grand Mediterranean *featuring* Ponza & Saint-Raphaël

Continue to Ponza, a secret island of ancient Etruscan and Roman ruins and famed Blue Grottoes. A Marina Day at Golfo Stella, offers exclusive yacht-only seclusion amid translucent waters, perfect for water sports or relaxation. In Saint-Raphaël, a scenic Côte d'Azur resort town, Roman-era ruins, a lovely basilica, and the impressive Esterel Massif mountains await. Savour the authentic charm of Port Vendres, a fishing port nestled in the Mediterranean Pyrenees near the Spanish border, while in Mahón, capital of Menorca, the island’s thriving food scene and Georgian architecture take center stage. Your journey concludes in Palma de Mallorca, a rich tapestry of Moorish, Roman, and Christian influences.

sailings.title: Canary Islands *featuring* Casablanca & Tenerife

Begin with two nights in Casablanca, with the option of an overland visit to Marrakesh, before sailing to Lanzarote’s stark lava fields and white-sand beaches. An overnight in Tenerife brings distinctive island wines and UNESCO-listed Teide National Park, followed by the wild volcanic landscapes of El Hierro. A Marina Day off Mustique centres on time aboard, swimming in the marina terrace netted pool, and sampling the yacht’s collection of water toys. Wake to an uninterrupted horizon. Linger over lunch, spend an afternoon at L’Oceana Spa, or settle onto your private terrace as the light changes across the water. sailings.title: Lesser Antilles featuring Barbados & Dominica
sailings.body: This nine-night voyage  opens in St. John's and quickly settles into Caribbean rhythms with a call at Great Harbour, Jost Van Dyke, a laid-back seaside village set along powder-white sands and clear blue waters. A restorative sea day carries you south to discover Speightstown, gateway to golden beaches and UNESCO-recognized Bridgetown. Canouan follows, prized for its castaway beauty and exceptional snorkelling. A Marina Day in Soufrière Bay invites relaxation on the yacht’s marina terrace, framed by striking views of the volcanic Pitons, while Dominica’s Cabrits National Park reveals lush landscapes and abundant wildlife. In colonial Charlestown, play a round of golf at Four Seasons Resort Nevis before a Beach Day at Prickly Pear and debarkation in colourful Philipsburg complete the voyage.

Spend three days in the Floating City during Vernissage, moving between contemporary exhibitions, Renaissance masterpieces, and Murano’s time-honoured glassmaking tradition. Then leave the lagoon behind for an uninterrupted passage on *Four Seasons I*. Nice marks your return to shore, perfectly placed for the Cannes Film Festival and the energy it brings to the Riviera. Six nights connect two of Europe’s great cultural occasions, with the pleasures of yachting in between.

A Marina Day off the French Riviera trades coastal glitz for the freedom of open water, inviting guests to slow the pace and savour the beauty of the Mediterranean. From here, Four Seasons I continues to Palamós on Spain’s Costa Brava, a seafaring town of rugged coves and celebrated red prawns, before sailing on to Mallorca, concluding five unforgettable nights immersed in glamour, beauty and the effortless spirit of the Riviera.\n

sailings.body: Depart Las Palmas de Gran Canaria and follow the trade winds west across the Atlantic. Seven days at sea offer the rare luxury of uninterrupted time aboard: long mornings, leisurely lunches, spa rituals, and starlit evenings far from any shore. As the miles pass, the ocean reveals its vast and ever-changing moods, creating space to rest, reconnect, and embrace the rhythm of life at sea. Philipsburg greets you at the crossing’s end, the warm waters and island spirit of the Caribbean a fitting reward after the open ocean.

days.title: Las Palmas, Gran Canaria, Canarias, Spain
days.excerpt: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain, revels in sunshine year-round, with an exciting blend of urban energy and golden sands, perfect for relaxation.

days.title: At Sea, Atlantic Ocean
days.excerpt: Relaxation is the order of the day as you sail across the sparkling waters of the Atlantic.

days.title: Philipsburg, Sint Maarten
days.excerpt: Dive into Sint Maarten’s rich Dutch heritage and easygoing Caribbean atmosphere during your journey.
